verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS monitoring platform with AI features (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI-powered AI resolution), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence contains no documented control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The available controls are adjacent: client-side scrubbing of sensitive data before sending and disabling IP address storage. Neither of these addresses AI training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
